name: Day of the New Crescent (eššešu of Nanna)
source_ref: Ur III eššešu festival days 1/7/15 of the moon god at Ur (W. Sallaberger, Der kultische Kalender der Ur III-Zeit, 1993); the moon month begins at first visibility of the crescent

name: Seventh-Day eššešu
source_ref: eššešu on day 7 (Sallaberger 1993); day 7 among the unfavourable days of the hemerologies (A. Livingstone, Hemerologies of Assyrian and Babylonian Scholars, 2013)

name: Šapattu (the full moon's rest and eššešu)
source_ref: šapattu = the 15th, the full-moon day (CAD Š/1 s.v. šapattu); eššešu on day 15 (Sallaberger 1993)

name: Ibbû (the day of wrath)
source_ref: the 19th = 49th day from the previous new moon, the ibbû day of wrath (Livingstone 2013)

name: Bubbulum (the moon's disappearance)
source_ref: bubbulum/ūm bubbuli, the day of the moon's invisibility at month's end (CAD B s.v. bubbulu)
